sources.title: LoRA fine-tuning Hyperparameters Guide | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: LoRA hyperparameters are tunable settings that govern how Low-Rank Adaptation fine-tunes LLMs. With many choices (e.g., learning rate and epochs) and countless combinations, picking the right values is key to accuracy, stability, quality, and fewer hallucinations.
